datasets.title: Hallem & Carlson 2006: ORN responses
datasets.description: Every ORN response the paper tabulates, as the change in spike rate from the spontaneous rate: its 110 odors at 10^-2, 10 of them at 10^-4, 10^-6 and 10^-8, and 9 fruits pure (@ 0) and at 10^-2 to 10^-6 (its supplemental tables). Each receptor as its glomerulus (DM3: Or47a). What ORN data is scaled to before a baseline model is run on it (Models tab).
datasets.source: Hallem & Carlson, Cell 125 (2006) 143-160; as tabulated in olfsysm (hc_data.csv), made by reference_data/make_hallem.py
